summary:
Review of the direction "changes" (Changes feed) is complete. Invoked skills: ariakit-general-workflow, ariakit-general-code-style (no Visonaut-specific skill exists). I captured and read the full matrix (73 captures: every scenario at 1440 dark, each main scenario in light, at 390 and at 768, review at 1920, data=today, and the brand, canvas, radius, and density values), ran keyboard, pointer, and touch flows, and fixed what I found. Final state: the matrix reports no console error or warning, no horizontal overflow, and one h1 on every capture. Type check is clean for the whole lab. oxlint and oxfmt --check are clean for the 57 files of this direction.

MAIN DEFECTS THAT I FOUND AND FIXED
1. Review: the page moved each time a control in a sticky bar took the focus again (a menu or a popover closed): 58 px each time, down to the top of the page. Cause: the stock shell gives every element with an id in the main column a scroll margin of the height of the sticky bars. Fix: one class on the toolbar, the change bars, and the box bands:
   `export const noScrollMargin = "[&_[id]]:[scroll-margin-block-start:0px]!";`
2. Review: after A on the last change of a screenshot in the large run, the next change ended above the toolbar (its bar at y = 19, the change not visible). Cause: the reveal ran for a fixed 420 ms, and a fold ends later when frames are slow. Fix: the reveal now ends when the target stood still for 250 ms (limit 2.5 s), and a key or a press of the person ends it.
3. Review: the screenshot key was absent from a stuck change bar after a jump (for example after Shift+A). Cause: the observer watched the top edge of a section, and a section that jumps from below the screen to above the line never crosses it. Fix: the observer root is now one line under the toolbar, so the state is right after any jump.
4. Review, data=today: no change had a highlight, because the API of today sends no regions. A change of 100 pixels was invisible. Fix: the page reads the regions from the mask that the API sends today (new file mask-regions.ts, the same rule as the proposed API field).
5. Review tree: names were cut ("wrapped-acr…", "segmented-c…") because each row had a dot for every unchanged variant. Fix: tree rows show only the marks of changed variants, as the brief says.
6. Review: a stuck bar and every bar on a phone did not name the shared axis ("Light" without "WebKit"). Fixed. On a phone the decision bar of a short feed was in the middle of the page: it is now on the bottom edge. The jump bar printed "0/3" without a cursor. The Finish popover printed "0 rejected".
7. Run top bar (kit): below 56rem the state badge lay over the run number, and after a first fix the bar cut the badge. Both fixed at 390, 768, and 900.
8. Pull request page: the attempts box was 12 px narrower than the merge box and had lost its radius (nested frame pitfall). The state text was right-aligned and wrapped to three lines on a phone. Now the state follows "Attempt N" in one column, the time is at the end, and a phone has two lines. Copy now follows the brief ("Rejected · 15 to review · 1 rejected").
9. Sign-in: the sample change was louder than the gate, and its first region ring was a 6 px square. The sample text is now at ink 50, and the rings follow the review page.
10. Lists: the loading line was inset in the column 10 px under the top bar. It is now directly under the top bar and as wide as the page (queue, history, status, pull). The empty queue no longer shows the "/ filter" hint. The Captures meter of the status page no longer uses the success color.

ALSO VERIFIED: the extra scenarios that the builders never saw in a browser (status overflow, pull waiting, capture-failed, and error, review expired, error, and probes, history error). I mapped them to catalog scenarios for one capture run and restored the files after it. All render without errors. I corrected the copy of the expired run ("The images of this run expired.").

THINGS TO KNOW
- I ran oxfmt two times on whole surface folders (pages/pull, pages/sign-in, pages/review) and not only on the files of this direction. oxfmt changes format only, but it can have rewritten files of other directions there. I cannot list them, because apps/lab is untracked. Later runs used only the paths of this direction.
- Key latency in the large run (246 changes) is still about two times that of a normal run in the dev build. I added content-visibility: auto to far sections (measured gain 10% to 15%). The root cause is the :has() rules of the stock style sheet, as the lead reported.
- New file: /Users/diegohaz/Developer/visonaut/.claude/worktrees/serialized-dazzling-pixel/apps/lab/src/explorations/pages/review/changes/mask-regions.ts . Scripts and flow captures are in /Users/diegohaz/.claude/jobs/f65a6229/tmp/design/scratch/changes/reviewer/ .
- Not in the API (new): the changed regions of a variant in today mode are read from the mask image in a canvas. In production the mask must be readable by a canvas (same origin, or CORS headers).

The first region ring was a 6 px square: the rings now use the rule of the review page (a little outside the region, never smaller than 24 px, small radius)
remaining: The gate and the sample are centered in the height of the page; the brief draws them near the top
The pull request number is a constant (7754), and the heading without a target ("Sign in to Visonaut") has no scenario
The sample shows only from 64rem, so a tablet shows the card alone
